meta.label: Why this matters (reflection, not evidence)
meta.verses_checked: BSB via bible.helloao.org, 29 Oct 2026, by TARS

fact-crucifixion.text: The cross means God did not love us from a distance. Jesus entered real suffering and real death for people who had not earned it.
fact-crucifixion.quote: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

fact-appearances-to-disciples.text: The risen Jesus came back for friends who had run away. If he met them in their fear and doubt, he can meet you in yours.

fact-paul-conversion.text: No one is too far gone. Grace turned the church's fiercest opponent into one of its boldest messengers, and it can rewrite your story too.
fact-paul-conversion.quote: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.

fact-james-conversion.text: If people in your family doubt, take heart. Even Jesus' own brother did not believe at first, yet he became a leader of the church.
fact-james-conversion.quote: For even His own brothers did not believe in Him.

fact-early-creed-1cor15.text: You stand on the same message the first believers stood on: Christ died for our sins, was buried, and was raised on the third day.
fact-early-creed-1cor15.quote: Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures

fact-empty-tomb.text: Death does not get the last word, for Jesus or for anyone who trusts him. Every grave we stand beside is answered by the angel's words.
fact-empty-tomb.quote: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said!
